blocks.text: SHANGHAI–Leylah Fernandez defeated Marie Bouzkova in straight sets on Saturday to reach the 2026 Ningbo Open final and is one victory away from her second WTA title in as many months. The Canadian world number 30 won 6-3, 7-5 and will face top-ranked Elena Rybakina or Russia’s Diana Shnaider in the championship decider in eastern China on Sunday. Fernandez won her first title of the year in the Singapore Open last month and had too much for the 26th-ranked Bouzkova of the Czech Republic.
